Name: Panning Upgrades - Deprecated -
Author: drbirbdev
Description:
[i][size=4]Upgrade the basic pan the same way you would other tools.[/size][/i]

[list]
[*]Visit Clint with some bars to upgrade your pan!
[*]Get an iridium pan for up to 5x the amount of ore/treasures per panning spot!
[*]Wear any pan as a hat!
[*]Configurable rates for extra draws/impact of luck
[/list]
Compatible with [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/4161]Better Panning[/url]﻿!  Use them together to make panning a lucrative endeavor.

No known incompatible mods.  Please share mod incompatibilities on Nexus.

Doesn't work on Android.

[i][size=4]How To Install[/size][/i]
Download, unzip, and place the PanningUpgrades folder into the Stardew Valley Mod folder.

If installing on an existing file where the pan has already been unlocked:
[list]
[*]You can upgrade the existing pan at the Blacksmith, and get the Steel Pan
[*]Until upgrading, this mod won't affect the existing pan
[/list]
To uninstall:
[list]
[*]Put pan in inventory
[*]Run [font=Courier New]pan_removepan[/font] in the SMAPI console to get rid of the pan
[*]Run [font=Courier New]pan_giveoriginalpan[/font] in the SMAPI console to get the old pan back
[*]End the day to save the game
[*]Delete the PanningUpgrades folder from the Stardew Valley Mod folder
[/list]
